arxiv-1704-03034.title: On a theorem of Campana and Păun
arxiv-1704-03034.creator: Christian Schnell
arxiv-1704-03034.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Christian Schnell. Let X X be a smooth projective variety over the complex numbers, and Δ ⊆ X \Delta\subseteq X a reduced divisor with normal crossings. We present a slightly simplified proof for the following theorem of Campana and Păun: If some tensor power of the bundle Ω X 1 ​ ( log ⁡ Δ ) \Omega_{X}^{1}(\log\Delta) contains a subsheaf with big determinant, then ( X , Δ ) (X,\Delta) is of log general type.

arxiv-2107-00949.title: Embodiment and Computational Creativity
arxiv-2107-00949.creator: Christian Guckelsberger, Anna Kantosalo, Santiago Negrete-Yankelevich, Tapio Takala
arxiv-2107-00949.description: Abstract We conjecture that creativity and the perception of creativity are, at least to some extent, shaped by embodiment. This makes embodiment highly relevant for CC ( CC ) research, but existing research is scarce and the use of the concept highly ambiguous.

arxiv-2109-04684.title: Enhancing Unsupervised Anomaly Detection with Score-Guided Network
arxiv-2109-04684.creator: Zongyuan Huang, Baohua Zhang, Guoqiang Hu, Longyuan Li, Yanyan Xu, Yaohui Jin
arxiv-2109-04684.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zongyuan Huang, Baohua Zhang, Guoqiang Hu, Longyuan Li, Yanyan Xu, Yaohui Jin. Anomaly detection plays a crucial role in various real-world applications, including healthcare and finance systems. Owing to the limited number of anomaly labels in these complex systems, unsupervised anomaly detection methods have attracted great attention in recent years.

arxiv-2201-12679.creator: Alfredo Zaragoza
arxiv-2201-12679.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alfredo Zaragoza. In a previuos paper the author asked if there exists a one-dimensional space X X that is not almost zero-dimensional, such that the dimension of the hyperspace of compact subsets of X X is one-dimensional. In this short note we give examples of spaces X X that are not almost zero-dimensional such that X X is one-dimensional and their hyperspace of compacta of X X also is one-dimensional. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 54F65, Secondary: 54F50, 54A10, 54B20, 54H05.

arxiv-2208-05858.title: Search for LBVs in the Local Volume galaxies: study of two stars in NGC 1156 2022 Search for LBVs in the Local Volume galaxies: study of two stars in NGC 1156 – References

arxiv-2208-05858.description: Abstract We continue the search for luminous blue variables (LBVs) in Local Volume galaxies in order to study their fundamental parameters. In this paper, we report the discovery of two new LBVs in the dwarf irregular galaxy NGC 1156. Both stars exhibit spectral variability simultaneously with strong brightness variations: Δ ​ R c = 0.84 ± 0.23 m \Delta\text{R}_{c}=0.84\pm 0.

arxiv-2502-18163.title: You Shall Not Pass: Warning Drivers of Unsafe Overtaking Maneuvers on Country Roads by Predicting Safe Sight Distance
arxiv-2502-18163.creator: Adrian Bauske, Arthur Fleig
arxiv-2502-18163.description: Abstract . Overtaking on country roads with possible opposing traffic is a dangerous maneuver and many proposed assistant systems assume car-to-car communication and sensors currently unavailable in cars. To overcome this limitation, we develop an assistant that uses simple in-car sensors to predict the required sight distance for safe overtaking.

arxiv-2505-13367.title: Reflection phase shifts of bouncing Bogoliubov waves
arxiv-2505-13367.creator: Carsten Henkel
arxiv-2505-13367.description: Abstract The Bogoliubov–de Gennes equations are solved for an inhomogeneous condensate in the vicinity of a turning point, addressing the full continuous spectrum. A basis change in the space of the two Bogoliubov “particle” and “hole” amplitudes is introduced that decouples them approximately.

arxiv-2511-10080.title: The zipper condition for 4 4 -tensors in two-dimensional topological order and the higher relative commutants of a subfactor arising from a commuting square
arxiv-2511-10080.creator: Yasuyuki Kawahigashi
arxiv-2511-10080.description: Abstract They recently study two-dimensional topological order in condensed matter physics in terms of tensor networks involving certain 3 3 - and 4 4 -tensors. Their 3 3 -tensors satisfying the “zipper condition” play an important role there. We identify their 4 4 -tensors with bi-unitary connections in Jones’ subfactor theory in operator algebras with precise normalization constants.

arxiv-2512-13648.title: The impact of non-Gaussianity when searching for Primordial Black Holes with LISA
arxiv-2512-13648.creator: H. Veermäe
arxiv-2512-13648.description: Abstract LISA can observe cosmological millihertz (mHz) gravitational wave (GW) backgrounds that may offer a decisive test for asteroid-mass primordial black hole (PBH) dark matter (DM). In standard scenarios, failing to detect a scalar-induced gravitational wave (SIGW) background would exclude the last viable window for PBH DM formed through critical collapse.

pmc-11432330.title: Novel Drug-like HsrA Inhibitors Exhibit Potent Narrow-Spectrum Antimicrobial Activities against Helicobacter pylori
pmc-11432330.creator: Javier Casado, Irene Olivan-Muro, Sonia Algarate, Eduardo Chueca, Sandra Salillas, Adrián Velázquez-Campoy, Elena Piazuelo, María F Fillat, Javier Sancho, Ángel Lanas, Andrés González, Giuseppe Zanotti
pmc-11432330.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Helicobacter pylori infection constitutes a silent pandemic of global concern. In the last decades, the alarming increase in multidrug resistance evolved by this pathogen has led to a marked drop in the eradication rates of traditional therapies worldwide. By using a high-throughput screening strategy, in combination with in vitro DNA binding assays and antibacterial activity testing, we identified a battery of novel drug-like HsrA inhibitors with MIC values ranging from 0.031 to 4 mg/L against several antibiotic-resistant strains of H.

pmc-12617785.title: Beyond the T-junction: Reinforce strategic sites in superomedial pedicle mammoplasties using a dual dermal flap technique
pmc-12617785.creator: Clelia Dogny, Matteo Scampa, Tom Membrez, Giulia Frigerio, Patricia E. Engels, Daniel Felix Kalbermatten, Dominik André-Levigne
pmc-12617785.description: IntroductionBreast reduction using superior or superomedial pedicles provides favorable long-term aesthetic outcomes, particularly regarding breast shape and projection. However, wound dehiscence remains a concern at the T-junction and the vertical–areolar junction, with reported rates ranging from 4 % to 20 %, contributing to a higher postoperative burden, suboptimal aesthetic results, and increased healthcare costs.

pmc-13074558.title: Amino–MIL-101(Fe)/Chitosan–Graphene Oxide Cross-Linked Nanocomposite for High-Performance Adsorptive Remediation of Wastewater Microplastics from Environmental Samples
pmc-13074558.creator: Amr A. Yakout, Ahmed S. Badr El-din, Amani Al Solami, Abeer H. Aljadaani
pmc-13074558.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). One of the main sources of microplastic pollution in aquatic ecosystems is municipal wastewater, and preserving the ecological security of water depends on its effective removal. In this study, a potential multi-functionalized nanocomposite (NH2-MIL-101(Fe)/CS/GO), which consists of an iron-based metal–organic framework (NH2-MIL-101(Fe)) integrated with chitosan (CS) as a biopolymer matrix and graphene oxide (GO) as a conductive support, was exploited to enhance microplastic removal via different adsorptive hydrophilic/hydrophobic interactions.

pmc-13207983.title: Analysis of Appressorium Formation in Metarhizium anisopliae and Its Impact on the Defense Metabolism of Opisina arenosella Larvae Based on LC-MS
pmc-13207983.creator: Yang Xu, Canxia Wu, Haining Zhang, Dongxu Wang, Huaxin Cai, Hui Wu, Yinghua Tong
pmc-13207983.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigates how the appressorium formation of the entomopathogenic fungus Metarhizium anisopliae enhances its pathogenicity against Opisina arenosella larvae. By inhibiting appressorium formation with sulforaphane, a higher formation rate correlated with increased virulence and faster killing. Post-formation, 102 differential compounds (e.g., L-sorbitol, L-aspartic acid) were detected on the larval cuticle, primarily benzenes, amino acids, and heterocyclic compounds.

pmc-13238578.title: Synergistic Effects of Normal‐Range Serum Sodium and Potassium on Mortality: The Modifying Role of Inflammation From a NHANES Cohort Analysis
pmc-13238578.creator: Haofeng Zhang, Fudong He, Zhenger Fang, Guangjun Zheng, Biying Zhou, Xia Chen, Mingliang Liu, Guang Hao
pmc-13238578.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate the associations of serum sodium and potassium levels within the normal range with cardiovascular (CV) and all‐cause mortality, and to further explore the potential roles of oxidative stress and inflammatory biomarkers in these associations.MethodsWe analyzed NHANES 1999–2018 data from 32,837 adults with normal baseline serum sodium (135–146 mmol/L) and potassium (3.5–5.0 mmol/L), stratified by tertiles.

pmc-13297278.creator: Marios Sagris, Athanasios Makris, Svetlana Aghayan, Stergios Soulaidopoulos, Alexios Giannakodimos, Konstantinos Platanias, Andreas Tzoumas, Nikolaos Ktenopoulos, Konstantinos Pamporis, Nikolaos Stalikas, Gerasimos Gavrielatos, Efstratios Karagiannidis, Nikolaos Patsourakos, Dimitris Tousoulis, Kons
pmc-13297278.description: Coronary artery disease (CAD) is the leading cause of mortality, with percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) constituting the gold standard treatment. However, in an important proportion of the cases, lesion severity is debatable since conventional angiography provides only a two-dimensional representation of the vessel lumen and fails to quantify ischemic significance or plaque morphology.

pmc-13300967.title: The interplay between total and left atrial pericardial fat and atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis of their associations with AF onset, duration, recurrence, and postoperative
pmc-13300967.creator: W Kociemba, M Gawalko
pmc-13300967.description: IntroductionPericardial adipose tissue (PAT) has been implicated as a significant substrate for atrial fibrillation (AF) pathogenesis, maintenance, recurrence, and new-onset. Nonetheless, the evidence remains inconclusive. PAT promotes atrial remodelling through inflammation, oxidative stress, fat infiltration and fibrosis. Measuring it may aid in predicting AF onset and recurrence as well as serve as a potential therapeutic strategy.

pmc-13330469.title: The expert learner: using the learning and study strategies inventory (LASSI) to investigate the characteristics of high-performing medical students
pmc-13330469.creator: Killian J Bucci, Philip C Brewer, William S Wright, Mohammed K Khalil
pmc-13330469.description: BackgroundIdentifying the characteristics of high-performing medical students is essential for developing targeted interventions to support underperforming learners. This study examined the relationship between learning and study strategies, as measured by the Learning and Study Strategies Inventory (LASSI), and academic performance in medical school.MethodsThe LASSI was administered to 514 medical students (classes of 2019–2023) during the middle of the first year.

pmc-13368389.title: Jean-Ovide Decroly (1871–1932): neurologist and pedagogue
pmc-13368389.creator: Sylvain Wagnon, Norberto Dallabrida, Léo Coutinho, Hélio A. Ghizoni Teive
pmc-13368389.description: The present article aims to understand Ovide Decroly1s intervention in the pedagogical field considering his medical-neurological training. Thus, it shows that, in 1901, Decroly founded an institute of special education and, 6 years later, created the Hermitage School, for disabled and so-called normal children respectively.
